enabled.label: Self-Learning
enabled.help: Enable automatic skill discovery from repeated workflows.

mode.label: Learning Mode
mode.help: off: disabled. suggest: generates candidates for manual review. auto: promotes high-confidence candidates automatically.

fingerprint.minOccurrences.label: Min Occurrences
fingerprint.minOccurrences.help: How many times a tool sequence must repeat before a skill draft is generated.

fingerprint.minSessions.label: Min Sessions
fingerprint.minSessions.help: How many distinct sessions must show the pattern before triggering extraction.

limits.maxCandidatesPerDay.label: Max Candidates / Day
limits.maxCandidatesPerDay.help: Maximum number of skill draft candidates generated per workspace per day.
